name: TC-99: customer can add an item to the cart and reach checkout through the real UI flow
description: The one true end-to-end cart path: open the item modal, click Add to Cart, open the cart via the floating View Cart button, and click through to /checkout. Every other checkout test seeds the cart via sessionStorage for speed — this test is the safety net that the real add-to-cart wiring (and the cart storage schema seedCart mimics) actually works.
